Project Commands:


Gradle:

To run tests from root project folder:

	./gradlew test

To run as 'dev' profile:

	./gradlew bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=dev'



Docker:

	Starting mysql container by passing password and an option to run from any host as environment variable:

		docker run --name better_banking \
				   -p 3306:3306 \
  				   -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD="root" \
  				   -e MYSQL_ROOT_HOST="%" \
  				   -e MYSQL_DATABASE=better_banking \
  				   -v mysql_data_1:/var/lib/mysql \
  				   \mysql:latest

		docker run --name acme \
  					-p 3308:3306 \
					-e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=123456 \
					-e MYSQL_ROOT_HOST="%" \
  				    -e MYSQL_DATABASE=acme \
					-v mysql_data_2:/var/lib/mysql \
					-d mysql:8.0



  	Connect to Mysql DB on docker:

  		mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p

  		mysql --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3308 --user=root -p

  		docker exec -it <container_name_or_id> mysql -u root -p

  		docker exec -it dc8f145c4f44 mysql --port=3308 -u root -p

  		


  		ALTER USER 'root'@'%' IDENTIFIED WITH caching_sha2_password BY '123456';
		
		FLUSH PRIVILEGES;





  	Keycloak:

  		docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:9001:8080 -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin -e KC_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7.2 start-dev --hostname-debug=true


  		docker run -e KEYCLOAK_ADMIN=admin -e KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin -e KC_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG  -p 127.0.0.1:9001:8080 quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:22.0.0 start-dev


  		docker cp <container_id_or_name>:/opt/keycloak/conf/keycloak.conf ./keycloak.conf

  		docker cp ./keycloak.conf <container_id_or_name>:/opt/keycloak/conf/keycloak.conf


  		docker run -d -p 9020:9020 -v ./keycloak.conf:/opt/keycloak/conf/keycloak.conf quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:latest start-dev

		    method: 'GET',
		    headers: {
		        'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN_STRING}`, // Must include the word 'Bearer' followed by a space
		        'Content-Type': 'application/json'

		    console.log("HTTP Response Code:", response.status); // Should now be 200 OK
		    return response.text(); 
		})
		.then(data => {
		    console.log("Response Body Payload:");
		    console.log(data ? JSON.parse(data) : "Empty Response Body");
		})
		.catch(error => console.error('Fetch System Error:', error));
